pkgmetadata.longdescription: AppleWin is an emulator of the Apple II, II Plus, //e and enhanced //e, and of clones such as the Pravets and TK3000, with many peripheral cards (Mockingboard, Disk II, hard disk, Super Serial Card, Uthernet, ...) and a symbolic debugger. This is the Linux port by Andrea Odetti, with SDL2, Qt6, ncurses and libretro frontends.

use.flag: Build the libretro core (applewin_libretro.so) for libretro frontends such as RetroArch
Emulate the Uthernet network cards through net-libs/libslirp
Build the SDL2 + Dear ImGui frontend with the debugger (sa2)
